name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-inbox
description: A workspace product of four microfrontend screens built from @gears-frontx/ui-kit: contacts (a filterable directory and each person's page), dashboard (KPI cards, charts, workload and recent activity), chat (channels, conversations, a reply-and-note composer and a link to the contact's page) and mail (mailboxes, a reading pane, reply and compose), each with mocked @gears-frontx/api services. Apply onto a project that already has template-shell, template-mfe and template-kit-candidates applied; the screens appear in the shell's menu without further wiring.
